watches.name: Arctic Circle Cult diver black
watches.description: Call us crazy, but we have this belief that things have souls. For instance, we have this Omega that Knut Gadd himself wore in the screaming 60’s, and we swear, it still smells of cigars, leather and cologne and just wearing it makes us stand a little taller. So, if watches truly have souls, then why not infuse their lives with some adventure before we hand them over to you? The Cult Diver Arctic Edition, dubbed the coolest watch in the world, is a special edition Cult Diver. It’s been where no watch has been before – at the bottom of an Arctic Lake. Sadly, the doors have now closed on this limited edition Cult Diver. But don’t fret, we’re planning new adventures, also limited editions, and all friends of Knut Gadd will be the first to know about these exclusive offerings. So stay tuned!

watches.name: Cult Diver Deep Blue
watches.description: Say hello to the perfect diver watch. What’s so perfect about it, you might ask? Well, for starters, it’s inspired by Knut Gadd himself, just like all of our watches. A connoisseur of life, Knut was a strapping man who knew to wear tweed in the Scottish Highlands, and how to drive a 356 with stick shift while nurturing a Martini in one hand. And that’s just the kind of watch the Knut Gadd Cult Diver is. A twin-personality companion that holds its own under water as much as above it. Trust it on any aquatic adventure, then casually slip into a dinner setting without changing your hardware. All while exuding that understated confidence we’ve come to expect from a worldly man. And if vintage is your thing, and rightly so, you will enjoy everything offered by the timeless design, from the domed glass to the swiss luminous and the black guilloche face. Once upon a time, all it took to be adventurous was a wooden motor yacht, a tailored shirt and a damn good watch. With the Cult Diver we carry that legacy onward, in honor of Knut himself. Technical specification CULT DIVER 41 mm wide / 45 mm including crown 13mm thickness 20 mm lugs / 48 mm lug distance Weight: 120 grams 100 meter water resistant 2-Year Worldwide Warranty Swiss super luminous in old radium High-domed h-grade mineral crystal Matte Aluminum top ring Precision cut SAWTOOTH Bezel 120-click bezel rotation Japanese Miyota quartz movement Guilloche dial Surgical level steel 100% non allergic / Marine grade Screw-Down Crown with Embossed logo EASILY interchangeable Steel bracelet Engraved backcase Engraved adjustable folded buckle Steel bracelet 20mm
